notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 28 part 1 (Internet Archive buildingengineer2828cont), the weekly issues from 7 January to 30 June 1928. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1927-1930, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1928. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 196 of the 276 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner (same surname at the owner's address) that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts (steel, marble, lathing, refrigeration, painting, flues) are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. The running heads of this volume are too garbled to date the issues, so issue dates come from the cover lines of the 26 issues (redate_covers.py), which are weekly and unbroken.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26 and 27 and vol. 28 part 1 read; the other 29 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 28 part 2 (July-December 1928, buildingengineer28128cont) next. In this volume: 376 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 446 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 643 rows were not placed: 336 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 172 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets), 134 printed street numbers with no EAS row today and 1 ambiguous.
coverage.note: 2,542 numbered entries read, 1,741 San Francisco rows, 1,098 placed on a parcel, 276 picked and read against the page image, 269 published on 247 pages (166 seeded), 7 held back at the image check (five same-issue listings merged into one entry, a use that contradicts the roll, a likely repeat of a December 1927 contract).
